entities.summary: Jeanne Mammen was a German painter, illustrator, and printmaker. Her work is associated with the New Objectivity, Symbolism, and Cubism movements. She is best known for her depictions of queer women and Berlin city life during the Weimar period. Jeanne Mammen was a painters & sculptors from Berlin (1890-11-21, Berlin–1976-04-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
